meta.description: Registry for non-local transport failure modes in Phase 2 of the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

failure_modes.name: transport_divergence
failure_modes.description: Transported states grow without bound or fail to reach an admissible target locus.

failure_modes.name: admissibility_leakage
failure_modes.description: Transport results in process states mapping outside all declared admissibility windows.

failure_modes.name: orientation_decoherence
failure_modes.description: Non-local transport results in the loss of coherent orientation frame alignment.

failure_modes.name: transport_aliasing
failure_modes.description: Distinct transport paths or target loci appear identical under the evaluated metrics.

failure_modes.name: branch_transport_explosion
failure_modes.description: Transport of multi-valued branches leads to an unconstrained increase in concurrent states.

failure_modes.name: non_reconstructable_transport
failure_modes.description: Target states cannot be uniquely or partially mapped back to their transport preimages.

failure_modes.name: residue_transport_instability
failure_modes.description: Residue updates during transport cycles destabilize target-state selection or persistence.

failure_modes.name: closure_failure_under_iteration
failure_modes.description: Repeated application of transport fails to maintain formal class membership or boundary constraints.
